content.purpose: Recognise where Linux keeps configuration, user data, logs, devices and programs.
content.mentalModel: Linux presents one tree rooted at /. Top-level directories are conventions with distinct jobs, not separate drive letters.

tasks.instruction: Inspect the root directory, then save the paths /etc, /home and /var as three lines in /home/student/answers/directory-tree.txt.

Use ls with the -d option so the directory names themselves are printed.
